outdated_citations.message: Draft mentions 43-grade cement using IS 8112:1989. This standard was withdrawn in 2015. Citing it in active tenders violates CVC procurement guidelines.

reasoning_trace.detail: Identified product 'Ordinary Portland Cement', grade '43', domain 'Highway'.
Dense vector search returned IS 269:2015 (score 0.92) and IS 8112:1989 (score 0.88).
Knowledge graph verified IS 8112:1989 is WITHDRAWN and consolidated into IS 269:2015.
Verified Cement (Quality Control) Order 2003 mandates BIS ISI certification for IS 269.

plain_language_explanation.text: For 43 grade Ordinary Portland Cement, the applicable Indian Standard is **IS 269:2015**. Note that older references like IS 8112:1989 have been withdrawn and consolidated into IS 269. Under the Cement QCO (2003), BIS ISI certification is legally mandatory. Tender clauses must also specify fineness testing as per IS 4031 (Part 1).

compliance_checklist.item: Cite IS 269:2015 in tender specification (do not cite withdrawn IS 8112:1989)
Mandatory BIS ISI Mark requirement clause
compliance_checklist.action_required: Insert clause: 'Supplied cement must bear valid BIS Certification mark under Cement QCO.'
Require vendor to provide 7-day and 28-day compressive strength test reports.
